mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome—I'm glad you're here. Have you ever wondered how the race for resources, the clash of powerful nations, and the constant push for bigger markets have come to shape the world we live in? Together, we're about to peel back the curtain on the forces that truly drive global politics and economics. With Vladimir Lenin’s classic, Imperialism: The Highest Stage of Capitalism, as our guide, we’ll uncover how the evolution of capitalism leads to fierce competition, the rise of monopolies, and the dominance of finance capital—all fueling a scramble for colonies and influence across continents. As we move through this journey, you'll start to see how economic interests aren't just numbers on a balance sheet—they're powerful forces steering political decisions and even military actions. We'll shine a light on the hidden connections between economic power and government policy, and look at how just a handful of wealthy nations end up calling the shots for so many others. It’s eye-opening to see how these dynamics of exploitation ripple within and between countries, challenging everything we might assume about progress and development. So, get ready—because we’re about to dive deep into the mechanics of imperialism, and discover what it really means for societies caught up in its wake. Let’s explore together, and see what truths we uncover.
